crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

translations.web: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
translations.bsb: When He is at work in the north, I cannot behold Him; when He turns to the south, I cannot see Him.
translations.kjv: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see
translations.asv: On the left hand, when he doth work, but I cannot behold him; He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him.
